verdict.rationale: Synthesia offers a documented developer API suite (Video, Upload, Billing APIs), and the Upload API is explicitly labeled "V2", which shows some API versioning. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or a versioning scheme across the APIs. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning strategy across all APIs (e.g. version headers or paths, changelog), independent corroboration of version stability.
